verdict.rationale: Phoenix's dataset evaluators are explicitly framed as 'an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite' and evals can be run programmatically via SDK without manual retry/concurrency handling, suggesting scriptability that could be wired into CI, but there is no direct documentation of a CI/CD integration, GitHub Actions example, or a deployment-gating mechanism based on eval thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration guide, exit-code/threshold-based pass/fail gating, and any hands-on/community evidence of running evals in CI to block releases.
